function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most prominent vaccine manufacturers worldwide, along with a brief note on what they’re best known for. If you’d like deeper details (e.g., financials, pipeline, recent news), just let me know and I can pull up the latest reports or links.

| # | Company | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines | Key Highlights |
|---|---------|--------------|------------------|----------------|
| 1 | **Pfizer** | New York, USA | COVID‑19 (Comirnaty), Prevnar 13, Tdap, HPV (Gardasil) | Largest COVID‑19 vaccine producer; strong biotech pipeline; partnership with BioNTech. |
| 2 | **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | COVID‑19 (Spikevax), RSV (mRNA‑1345, in trials) | Pioneer mRNA platform; rapid vaccine development; expanding into other infectious diseases. |
| 3 | **Johnson & Johnson (J&J)** | New Brunswick, USA | COVID‑19 (Janssen), HPV (Gardasil 9), Hepatitis B (Recombivax HB) | Single‑dose COVID‑19 vaccine; strong global distribution network. |
| 4 | **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | COVID‑19 (Vaxzevria), HPV (Cervarix), Influenza (Fluad) | Large global reach; partnership with Oxford University; focus on low‑cost vaccines. |
| 5 | **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | COVID‑19 (Novavax NVX-CoV2373), RSV (in trials) | Protein‑subunit platform; high‑efficacy COVID‑19 vaccine; strong manufacturing capacity. |
| 6 | **Sanofi Pasteur** | Lyon, France | HPV (Gardasil 9), Influenza (Fluzone), Hepatitis A (Vaqta) | One of the oldest vaccine producers; extensive global distribution; strong focus on public health. |
| 7 | **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | Brentford, UK | HPV (Gardasil 9), Influenza (Fluzone), Hepatitis B (Recombivax HB) | Diversified portfolio; strong R&D; active in emerging markets. |
| 8 | **Merck & Co. (MSD outside the U.S.)** | Kenilworth, USA | HPV (Gardasil), Influenza (Fluzone), Hepatitis B (Recombivax HB) | Global presence; strong oncology and vaccine pipeline. |
| 9 | **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | COVID‑19 (Covaxin), Hepatitis B (HBsAg) | Leading Indian vaccine maker; focus on affordable vaccines; strong domestic market. |
|10 | **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | COVID‑19 (CoronaVac), Hepatitis B (HBsAg) | Inactivated virus platform; large domestic and regional distribution. |
|11 | **Sinopharm** | Beijing, China | COVID‑19 (BBIBP‑CorV), Hepatitis B (HBsAg) | State‑owned; significant role in China’s vaccine strategy. |
|12 | **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | COVID‑19 (CVnCoV, in trials) | mRNA platform; focus on rapid vaccine development. |
|13 | **BioNTech** | Mainz, Germany | COVID‑19 (Comirnaty, in partnership with Pfizer) | mRNA pioneer; expanding into oncology and other infectious diseases. |
|14 | **GSK Vaccines** | Brentford, UK | HPV (Gardasil 9), Influenza (Fluzone) | Strong focus on public health and emerging disease preparedness. |
|15 | **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | COVID‑19 (Covishield, in partnership with AstraZeneca), Hepatitis B (HBsAg) | Largest vaccine manufacturer by volume; key player in global vaccine supply. |

### How to Use This List
- **Research**: If you’re looking into a specific vaccine’s manufacturer, start with the company’s official website or the latest SEC filings (for U.S. firms) or annual reports (for others).
- **Supply Chain**: For procurement or partnership inquiries, contact the company’s commercial or business development departments.
- **Regulatory**: Check the FDA, EMA, or WHO approvals for each vaccine to confirm status and indications.

---

#### Quick Links (clickable)
- **Pfizer** – https://www.pfizer.com/
- **Moderna** – https://www.modernatx.com/
- **Johnson & Johnson** – https://www.jnj.com/
- **AstraZeneca** – https://www.astrazeneca.com/
- **Novavax** – https://www.novavax.com/
- **Sanofi Pasteur** – https://www.sanofi.com/en/our-focus/healthcare/our-products/vaccines/
- **GSK Vaccines** – https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/our-work/vaccines/
- **Merck & Co.** – https://www.merck.com/
- **Bharat Biotech** – https://www.bharat-biotech.com/
- **Sinovac** – https://www.sinovac.com/
- **Sinopharm** – https://www.sinopharm.com/
- **CureVac** – https://www.curevac.com/
- **BioNTech** – https://biontech.de/
- **Serum Institute of India** – https://www.serum.in/

Let me know if you’d like more detailed data on any of these companies—financials, pipeline status, recent press releases, or anything else!
